help.body: Drag anywhere: each lane-width you drag moves the pack one lane. A tap moves one lane toward that side. Keys: arrows, A/D or H/L.
help.title: Switch lanes

help.body: Run into tips for $1 each. Smaller packs see a few more. Treats are carried, up to 3. Tap a doghouse to give its owner a treat: +1♥.
help.title: Tips and treats

help.body: Hit a skunk, puddle or thief and the walk pauses. Pick a card: pay up, or upset the owners. Every card shows its outcome; hold one for details. One is always free. Cones and bins just cost a few tips. Some bumps are lucky, like a lost wallet.
help.title: Bumps become cards

help.body: Each owner has a happiness meter: ♥. Bumps and choices raise or lower it. At 0♥ the owner fires you and the dog goes home. That zone pays nothing for them; earlier fees stay yours.
help.title: Keep owners happy

help.body: A bubble and a dotted line over a dog mean a pull. It tugs the pack one lane toward what it wants, never into an obstacle. Drag back any time.
help.title: Watch for pulls

help.body: Each dog has a need: Friendly, Playful, Nosy, Regular or Thirsty. When it's urgent, a bubble shows and the dog pulls toward its spot. Steer into the spot for a happy owner. Left too long, it goes wrong.
help.title: Needs

help.body: Walk 4 zones of Maplewood, picking the next at each fork. Every dog pays its fee after each zone. Between zones, pick an upgrade card. Head home any time from the pause menu.
help.title: Four zones
